requirement_text: Luminaires shall be LED type suitable for street lighting on arterial roads, with minimum luminous efficacy of 130 lm/W and correlated colour temperature between 4000K and 5000K.
standard_title: LED Road and Street Luminaire - Performance Requirements
notes: direct scope match - LED street luminaire performance

requirement_text: The street lighting luminaire housing and optical compartment shall provide IP66 ingress protection to prevent dust and water ingress under outdoor exposure.
standard_title: LED Road and Street Luminaire - Performance Requirements
notes: IS 16107 mandates minimum IP66 for outdoor LED street luminaires

requirement_text: Driver circuitry shall have surge protection of at least 10kV and shall include thermal auto-cutoff to prevent overheating during sustained overvoltage events.
standard_title: LED Road and Street Luminaire - Performance Requirements
notes: surge immunity and thermal protection are covered performance requirements in IS 16107

requirement_text: PVC insulated single core cables used for internal wiring shall be rated for working voltages up to 1100V and shall conform to the current national standard for insulation thickness and conductor sizing.
standard_title: LED Road and Street Luminaire - Performance Requirements
notes: easy negative - luminaires, not cable manufacturing

requirement_text: The motor shall be rated for continuous duty (S1) as per the classification of rating and duty types applicable to rotating electrical machines.
standard_title: LED Road and Street Luminaire - Performance Requirements
notes: easy negative - lighting, not rotating machinery
